author: PavelMakarchuk
body:
The $1,700 is 2 × $850 (Maine's relief payment is per adult; this joint couple at ~$108k AGI is under the $200k joint cap). On the timing — This is the rebate-timing convention we closed out in #1068: PolicyEngine books one-time rebates to the year whose return determines them; `taxsimtest` default mode books the payment year; and — key point — **your own `opt(27)=1`/`opt(30)=1` (set on this very record's txpydata) books the eligible year, same as PE**. TaxAct returns show neither, since these are administrative payments, not return line items. For comparisons we ship three tools: the `srebate` output column, `compare --net-of-rebates`, and `compare --taxsim-opt30` (#1070/#1074). If you'd rather both engines exclude rebates from `siitax` entirely (matching the TA return), that's `opt(27)=2` on your side and `--net-of-rebates` on ours — happy to converge on that as the standard if you prefer it.

One extra wrinkle for Maine specifically: your `opt(27)=1` currently books the $850s in **neither** year (removed from 2022 but not booked into 2021) — that's the coverage gap filed with records in **#1075**.
